title: This Lizard Shoots Blood From Its Eyes Up to 5 Feet

scenes.text: This lizard shoots blood from its eyes. Up to five feet.
It's called a horned lizard, and it uses the trick on dogs and coyotes.
It blocks blood from leaving its head, so the pressure bursts tiny vessels near its eyes.
Then the blood sprays from the corners of its eyes.
The blood tastes foul to dogs and foxes, so they shake their heads and back off.
Birds, though, don't seem to care.
A lizard with a blood cannon for a face.

description:
A horned lizard can squirt blood from its eyes up to five feet.
It blocks blood leaving its head until tiny vessels burst, and the foul-tasting spray sends dogs and coyotes running.
What is the weirdest defence you have ever seen?
first_comment: Would a blood-squirting lizard scare you off or make you curious?
